description: Na₂CoNiF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.42 Å) and four longer (2.75 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Co is bonded to six F atoms to form CoF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoF₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-44°. There are four shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) Co-F bond lengths. Ni is bonded to six F atoms to form NiF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.06 Å) Ni-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Ni atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Ni tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one Ni atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Co atoms.
